gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YA AFTER EFFECTS - MAKAMBO YA SIKA
Version 9.2.8  -  Octobre 2026
================================================================================

Panneau ezali sikoyo kolobela NDINGA 132, ezali na BA THÈME YA SIKA YA DEMON SLAYER
na mopanga oyo ekataka ba bouton ozali kofina, mpe ba correction mwa moke ya mise en page mpe ya Windows.

LIBOSO YA KOBANDA
- Installer likolo ya version na yo ya sikoyo na installateur ya ZXP na yo ya ntango
  nyonso, sima banda After Effects lisusu mbala moko.
- Ba réglage na yo, thème, ba preset mpe ba expression oyo obombaki ekotikala.

SIKA: PANNEAU NA NDINGA 132
- Flex Réglages > LANGUE ezali sikoyo kolakisa ndinga 132, na boîte ya koluka.
  Pona moko mpe panneau mobimba ekobongwana: ba onglet, ba bouton, ba astuce, ba message.
- Ndinga nyonso ebongolamaki na AI uta na panneau ya Anglais, liloba na liloba te.
  Ba nkombo oyo ozali komona na projet na yo (nkombo ya ba layer, ya ba effet) etikali
  na Anglais po ekokana naino na After Effects.
- Popup ya "makambo ya sika" ebongolami mpe, banda version oyo.

SIKA: BA THÈME YA DEMON SLAYER
- Flex Réglages > SELECTEUR DE THEME ezali na groupe ya sika ya DEMON SLAYER na ba thème 11:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen mpe Kokushibo.
- Tambolisa souris likolo ya panneau mpe eloko ya thème ekolanda yango: mai, moto,
  éclair, ba papillon, ba pétale, brume mpe bisusu. Ntango souris etelemi,
  ekozimba.
- Fina na bouton mpe mopanga ya personnage wana ekokata yango. Tikala kofina bouton
  ya gauche mpe ekoba kokata; tikala kofina yango pene ya sekonde 2.5 mpe ekopasuka.
- Esalemi po etikala pɛpɛ: ba effet esalaka kaka ntango ozali kotambolisa souris to
  kofina, mpe na ba ordinateur ya malembe ekomi pɛpɛ yango moko. Zimbisa BA EFFECT YA
  AMBIANCE na Sélecteur de thème po obatela kaka ba couleur.

EBONGWANI: BA BOUTON PLAT NA BA THÈME NYONSO
- Ba bouton ya actif mpe ya liboso na ba thème ya couleur esalelaka lisusu te dégradé ya
  likolo kino na nse. Ezali couleur moko plat na mwinda ya pete, boye emonani peto
  mpe etangami malamu.

ELONGISAMI
- Carte ya licence mpe popup ya "makambo ya sika" ekokaki kofungwama moko likolo ya
  mosusu. Sikoyo ekozipana lisusu te, mpe badge ya MISE A JOUR ezipaka lisusu te
  ba bouton na likolo ya panneau.
- Na ECHELLE UI 125% mpe 150%, ba fenêtre mosusu (lokola Flex Réglages) ekokaki kokoma
  molai koleka panneau, boye bouton na yango ya kokanga ekendaki libanda ya komonana.
  Sikoyo fenêtre nyonso ekokɔta malamu na bonene nyonso.
- Windows: AutoCaptions ekokaki koloba "DRIVER YA NVIDIA EZALI YA KALA MINGI PO NA GPU
  CAPTIONS" na ba carte mpe ba driver ya sika (série RTX 40 mpe 50). Sikoyo ezali
  kotanga malamu support ya CUDA ya driver mpe ezali kosalela GPU na yo.

EBONGWANI TE
- Licence, activation mpe ba lien nyonso esalaka ndenge moko lokola liboso.
- Ba onglet mosusu nyonso mpe ba outil esalaka ndenge moko lokola na 9.2.7.
================================================================================

ult.message:
FLEX ULTIMATE YA PREMIERE PRO - MAKAMBO YA SIKA
Version 2.2.8  -  Octobre 2026

Ba caption ya CAPTION STACK ekomi sikoyo ba template ya Motion Graphics oyo ekoki
kobongisama na éditeur ya solo, ezali na AUDIO STUDIO ya sika mpe MARQUER BEATS AUDIO,
panneau ezali kolobela NDINGA 132, ECHELLE UI ekomi na ULTIMATE, mpe BA THÈME YA SIKA YA DEMON SLAYER.

LIBOSO YA KOBANDA
- Installer likolo ya version na yo ya sikoyo na installateur ya ZXP na yo ya ntango
  nyonso, sima banda Premiere Pro lisusu mbala moko.
- Ba réglage na yo, thème mpe ba preset ekotikala.

SIKA: CAPTION STACK - BA CAPTION OYO EKOKI KOBONGISAMA (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Ba caption etiami sikoyo lokola ba template ya Motion Graphics oyo ekoki kobongisama
  (Sortie > EDITABLE MOGRT, ezali sikoyo ndenge ya liboso na Premiere Pro 2026). Sima
  ya kotia, okoki kobongola liloba nyonso, police, couleur, bonene, esika, glow, contour,
  boîte, animation to ntango na panneau Essential Graphics ya Premiere.
- Sortie > BA IMAGE etiaka naino liloba nyonso lokola elilingi na lolenge ekokani
  mpenza, soki olingi bongo.
- Ba template eyei elongo na panneau. Eloko moko te ya kotelecharger.

SIKA: ÉDITEUR YA CAPTION STACK
- Aperçu emonisi sikoyo image ya solo ya video na yo na nse ya caption nyonso.
- Benda caption po okende na yango esika mosusu, salela coin po obongola bonene mpe point
  ya likolo po obalusa yango, fina mbala mibale na liloba po obongola yango. CAPTION
  MOBIMBA ekendisaka maloba nyonso esika moko, LILOBA MOKO ekendisaka liloba moko kaka.
- Pona soki mbongwana ekosalema na ba caption nyonso to na caption oyo kaka, mpe
  bomba ba disposition na yo po osalela yango lisusu.
- Ba look 10 ya sika ya GLOW: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow mpe Superb.

SIKA: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Pona clip ya audio, pona effet mpe fina SALELA. Nyonso esalemaka na
  ordinateur na yo.
- Ba preset 30 ya mbala moko: Na nse ya mai, Bass Boost, reverb ya Chambre / Salle /
  Cathédrale / Plaque, Écho, Téléphone, Radio, Mégaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Mongongo
  ya mozindo, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse mpe bisusu. Tia ba
  effet mingi boye olingi, bongola ordre na yango to zimbisa moko.
- Reverb ebatelaka mosisa na yango: mongongo ekobaka kobeta nsima ya nsuka ya clip, mpe
  etiami boye ete eloko moko te na timeline na yo ekobomama.
- Ba outil: Kolongola bruit, Kobongisa mongongo, Volume (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Kolongola ronflement, Compresseur, Limiteur, EQ,
  Vitesse mpe Pitch, Noise Gate, Kobimisa audio.
- STEMS MAKER ekabolaka loyembo na mongongo mpe miziki (to na ba stem 4). Ekotelecharger
  modèle na yango mbala ya liboso mpe ekotuna yo liboso.
- APERÇU etiki yo oyoka pene ya sekonde 8 na interrupteur Original / Traité.
  Résultat ekokende na piste audio ya libre mpe clip na yo ya originale ekozala muet,
  ekobomama ata mbala moko te.

SIKA: MARQUER BEATS AUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > MARQUER BEATS AUDIO)
- Pona clip ya miziki na timeline mpe fina MARQUER BEATS: Flex ezwaka ba beat mpe
  etiaka ba marqueur ya séquence likolo na yango, boye ba coupure na yo ekokani
  malamu na miziki.
- Pona BA HIT NYONSO, KICKS to SNARES, bongisa sensibilité, mpe marquer beat nyonso
  to mbala moko na ba beat mibale to minei.
- KOLONGOLA BA MARQUEUR YA BEAT elongolaka kaka ba marqueur oyo Flex etiaki. Esalemaka
  na ordinateur na yo.

SIKA: PANNEAU NA NDINGA 132
- Réglages > LANGUE ezali sikoyo kolakisa ndinga 132, na boîte ya koluka. Ba onglet,
  ba bouton, ba astuce mpe ba message nyonso ekobongwana. Popup ya "makambo ya sika"
